title: factory report --json
description: What `factory report <initiative> --json` (~/claudecode/scripts/factory/report.py) prints: the two charts of the autonomous-run report (chart 1: progress along the window; chart 2: where each roadmap track is) as numbers with their sources. Writer: Hephaistos (factory). Reader: Deltagos (organizer card lf57, the Overview section over a user-picked window). Times: every time is an integer epoch in seconds (UTC) unless the field name ends in _iso or is `generated` (ISO 8601 with the writer's local offset, for display only); a reader computes with the epoch ints. The sample is expected.json for the fixture make-fixture.sh builds. Rulings: `rulings` lists the decision records ruled in the window (--json only; --text does not show them).

initiative.description: The initiative id (working-on/initiative.yaml `id`, else the root's directory name).

root.description: Absolute path of the initiative root on the writer's machine. Machine-specific: the contract test ignores it (case.json ignore_fields).

generated.description: When the report was drawn (FACTORY_NOW or now), ISO 8601 with the local offset.

why.description: Present only when window is null: the one line saying why no window resolved (e.g. autonomous mode is not on now).

window.description: The window drawn, or null when none resolved (then `why` is set and progress/tracks are absent).

kind.description: given: --since/--until (what Deltagos passes for a user-picked window); autonomous: the last autonomous window that ended (default); current: the one on now, up to now.

source.description: Where the window came from: --since/--until, away-log.jsonl/away-archive/, or away.

since_iso.description: since as ISO 8601 with the local offset (display only).

until_iso.description: until as ISO 8601 with the local offset (display only).

progress.description: Chart 1: cards that passed review (added under working-on/done/, git committer time) in the window, cumulative, with dead time.

count.description: Cards moved to done/ in the window: 100% of chart 1. 0 means the text is one line (no card moved).

moves.description: Every card added under done/ in the window, first add per slug, in time order.

t.description: Committer time of the move, epoch s.

commit.description: Abbreviated hash of the commit that added it to done/.

lines.description: The bar rows: moves less than --gap minutes (20) apart share a line, drawn at the last move's time.

t.description: Time of the line (its last move), epoch s.

done.description: Cumulative cards done at this line.

hashes.description: Filled cells of the 34-cell text bar: round(34 * done / count).

dead.description: Dead time drawn in x, clipped to the window; overlapping causes merge into one span.

cause.description: usage limit, every seat stopped | no pulse row: no live seat, machine asleep or Argos down | memory outage; merged causes are joined by " + ".

source.description: pulse-history.jsonl | away digest, key ram:critical; merged sources joined by "; ".

notes.description: Lines printed under the denominator line, e.g. that dead time is not drawn (no pulse history) or drawn only from a later time.

tracks.description: Chart 2: each roadmap stage as a track, read from git at the last commit of working-on/ before window.until (a rerun prints the same numbers).

drawn.description: false: no tracks (no git repo, no commit before until, or no roadmap and no stage: on any card); then only why (and maybe rev) are set.

why.description: When drawn is false: the one line saying why.

rev.description: Abbreviated hash of the commit the tracks are read at.

rev_time.description: That commit's committer time, epoch s.

envs.description: The environment columns (FACTORY_REPORT_ENVS, default ["local"]). Only local is computed; any other is "?".

goal.description: The shortest-path line: the current stage, cards left and what is in its way (up to 3), or why no goal is drawn.

tracks.description: Roadmap stages in roadmap order (roadmap: true), then stage: values not in the roadmap, then the unstaged track (id "").

id.description: Stage id; "" for cards with no stage:.

done.description: The stage's done date (roadmap.yaml), "" while open.

gates.description: Decision record numbers that gate the stage.

done_cards.description: Slugs of this stage in done/.

to_cut.description: Slugs named in cards: of a ruled record of this stage (or of a stage gate) that exist nowhere yet.

pct.description: round(100 * passed / planned); null when planned is 0.

waits.description: What the stage waits on: stage gates not ruled, open depends_on, decide:, next: owners.

what.description: A record number, a slug, or "<slug>: <text>".

who.description: Who it waits on (an owner), "" when unknown.

env.description: Per env column: local = pct (null when none planned); any other env "?" (no deploy record is read yet).

rulings.description: Decision records (working-on/decisions/<NNNN>-*.md, status ruled or superseded) whose ruling time falls in the window, read at the last commit of working-on/ before window.until, in ruled_at order. Absent when window is null; [] when none.

id.description: The record number as in its file name, e.g. "0003".

source.description: Where ruled_at came from: ruled_at = the record's own ruled_at field (RFC 3339 with an offset); git = the committer time of the first commit of working-on/ where the record's status is ruled (or superseded), used when the field is absent or unreadable.

commit.description: When source is git: abbreviated hash of that commit.

ruled_at.description: When it was ruled, epoch s.

ruled_at_iso.description: ruled_at as ISO 8601 with the local offset (display only).

ruled_by.description: The person who ruled, read from ruled_by as specs contracts/working-on/expected.json accepted_reading.ruled_by_reading gives it: `pablo (away mode)` is pablo; `operator` is the factory's operator (FACTORY_OPERATOR, pablo here); a Themis ruling is themis. "" when ruled_by is empty.

mode.description: How it was ruled (working-on facts.enums.ruled_mode): the record's ruled_mode when written and in agreement, else read from ruled_by (no mode written = present). null when ruled_mode and ruled_by disagree or ruled_mode is not a mode (then note says so; never guessed).

note.description: Present only when something was read around: ruled_at unreadable or without an offset (read from git), or ruled_mode disagreeing with ruled_by.
